overall: No current observational data is available for Atlanta on July 7, so the analysis relies entirely on model guidance and the NWS official forecast. The Heat Advisory referenced is issued by NWS Charleston and covers coastal Georgia counties near Savannah, not Atlanta metro.

The active market uses odd buckets, where the top bucket is 95–96°F at 21.1%; this bucket appears overpriced relative to model consensus, while the 91–93°F neighborhood (spanning odd bucket 91–92F) looks underpriced. Confidence in the 91–93°F range is moderate-to-high given three independent models and the official forecast agreeing, with low wind and minimal cloud cover supporting a near-forecast outcome.
